name: Twilight Ring of Lordship
label: Quest
description: Twilight Ring of Lordship: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, if you plan to go after the Abyssal High Council again, then you'll need another Twilight ring of lordship. Bring me more shards and signets and I'll make one for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, I see your convictions are strong. Not many will face that council of fiends!
Here's your ring, friend. May your will, and your fortune, stand firm.
